reason: The cited lines show the tool accepts a URL, sends a browser_navigate message with that URL, and may return the browser's current URL, title, and accessibility snapshot. This supports SINK because it can cause a browser request/navigation to an agent-supplied URL/host. It supports UNTRUSTED because the returned page title/snapshot can be controlled by the navigated web page. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not by themselves establish access to non-public host files, localhost/intranet resources, or credentialed SaaS data, so SECRET is insufficient.
